top_signals.title: Wall Street Races for Megadeals as Countdown Begins on Trump Era
top_signals.summary: President Donald Trump’s return to the White House changed the political calculus around mergers and acquisitions, reviving companies’ desire for dream deals that had become difficult to pull off. Now, corporate America is on the clock.

top_signals.title: What Sanctions Get Right

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
